name: Auto Update Image Attributes From Filename
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Auto Update Image Attributes From Filename automatically generates and updates your WordPress image metadata using the uploaded image filename.

When you upload an image, the plugin can automatically populate the following attachment fields:

  • Image Title
  • Alt Text
  • Caption
  • Description

This saves time, keeps your media library organized, and helps improve accessibility and SEO by eliminating the need to manually edit image attributes after every upload.

You can also customize how the filename is converted by removing special characters, numbers, or extra spaces before the image attributes are generated.

Features

  • Automatically update image attributes on upload.
  • Generate Image Title from the filename.
  • Generate Alt Text from the filename.
  • Generate Image Caption from the filename.
  • Generate Image Description from the filename.
  • Option to replace underscores (_), hyphens (-), and dots (.) with spaces.
  • Option to remove numbers from filenames.
  • Option to trim and remove extra spaces.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.
  • No coding required.

Benefits

  • Save time when uploading images.
  • Improve image SEO with meaningful metadata.
  • Increase website accessibility using descriptive alt text.
  • Keep your WordPress Media Library clean and organized.
  • Perfect for photographers, bloggers, WooCommerce stores, agencies, and content creators.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the “Auto Update Image Attributes From Filename” plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Click on Auto Image Attributes on the dashboard.
sections.faq:
How to setup Plugin?

Does not required much setup. Just activate the plugin and update the settings as per requirement.
